notes.title: After the Suns: Big Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone. 

As there are still many things that we are learning, two of them are: the meeting point and the actualization of the game itself.

We have noticed that there are many mistakes that we want to fix in After The Suns. Like graphic errors (excesive shadows and darkness at runtime) and gameplay (camera very close to the character), among others ...

Therefore, our intention with this note is to inform you that we are working on an update that it will radically modify everything about the videogame.

Some things will remain (like the 8 levels) but certain new features will appear (more challenges, sound enhancement, better level graphics, among others).

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QKwyaWPdjhk&list=PLFs2ia-mwKgfeLomY3L84bXm-MLBSOe-c&index=5

The reason for this future update is to learn from our mistakes.

Next, we share you a comparative video between the current videogame and the future update: 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v-SHnlz82Ec&list=PLFs2ia-mwKgfeLomY3L84bXm-MLBSOe-c&index=4

At the moment, we don't have an approximate date of when it will be released, since we want to polish all possible details and improve the experience of the game, so that the player can enjoy our video game even more.

Thanks you and Kinds Regards,
Ignacio Medina, Santiago Medina.

notes.title: After The Suns Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone. 

A patch has been published that corrects the following errors:


-Fix the error that is generated when Fhavin loses, causing the snake totem don`t open

-Correct the error that causes fhavin don`t drink from the source

We want to thank you in advance for the support you have given us.

until next time
